description: This Dart source file defines the UI screens for a quiz list and quiz details in a Flutter app, including quiz flow, rendering, and state management. It utilizes external data and components, and manages navigation between screens.

classes.name: QuizListScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget displaying a list of available quizzes as cards with navigation to quiz detail screens.

classes.name: QuizDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that renders a quiz question, options, and handles quiz flow, including navigation to results.

classes.name: QuizResultScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget showing the final score of the completed quiz with an option to finish.

methods.name: QuizListScreen.createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the quiz list screen.

methods.name: _QuizListScreenState.initState
methods.description: Initializes the quiz list state, creating a quiz progress store.

methods.name: _QuizListScreenState.build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the quiz list, rendering each quiz as a card with start buttons.

methods.name: _QuizListScreenState.onTap
methods.description: Handles navigation to quiz detail when a quiz card or 'Start' button is tapped, and updates progress afterwards.

methods.name: _QuizDetailScreenState.build
methods.description: Builds the quiz question and options interface for a specific quiz.

methods.name: _QuizDetailScreenState.onPressedOption
methods.description: Handles answer selection, updating score, and navigating to the result screen upon completion.

methods.name: QuizResultScreen.build
methods.description: Displays the final score and provides a button to complete the quiz process.
